name: When is the best time to complete renovations before listing my home?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to complete renovations before listing my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Completing renovations several weeks to a few months before listing is generally ideal. This allows time for any unexpected delays, cleaning, and staging the home properly. Rushing renovations can lead to incomplete work or added stress. Consulting with Kelby Contreras early in your planning process can help align your renovation timeline with optimal market conditions in your specific area, ensuring your home is ready to impress buyers when it hits the market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Complete renovations several weeks to a few months before listing to allow for delays, cleaning, and staging. Early consultation with your real estate agent helps align the timeline with market conditions.
